story: Once upon a time, there lived a tortoise in a small pond. He had two good friends, who were swans. One year, there was very little rain. The pond began to dry up, and the tortoise became worried. The swans said, “We are going to another lake with plenty of water. We can take you with us.” The tortoise felt happy. The swans brought a strong stick and said, “Hold the stick tightly with your mouth. We will carry it from both sides. But remember—do not open your mouth.” The tortoise agreed. As they flew high in the sky, people on the ground saw them and laughed. “Look! A flying tortoise!” they shouted. The tortoise became angry and wanted to reply. As soon as he opened his mouth—he fell down! Luckily, he survived, but he learned a lesson.
